metas.name: The Secret Lives of Bill Bartell
metas.overview: Bill Bartell was a multifaceted individual who traversed the punk rock scene, law enforcement, rodeo riding, and country music. Known for his unique contribution to punk rock through his label Gasatanka Records and band White Flag, Bartell's life defies conventional boundaries, blending hyper-masculinity with subcultural rebellion. His story, filled with mysterious and seemingly contradictory roles, offers a compelling narrative about identity, transformation, and the unexpected paths life can take.

metas.name: Yet Another Family Drama
metas.overview: An estranged son gets an unexpected visit from his mother. As old conflicts are reignited, their flames become a fascinating show for a stranger, who just happens to have spent the night over.

metas.name: Eclissi di un rapporto
metas.overview: A man tells his boyfriend what to do to save a difficult relationship. Allowing a third man into the couple accelerates the inevitable decline of their feelings for each other.

metas.name: Park Life
metas.overview: Noah and Medhi didn’t expect to make any real connections when they encountered one another cruising in a park. But what starts as a meaningless and transactional hookup, soon blossoms into something unexpectedly romantic and meaningful as they wander the quiet streets of London one remarkable night.

metas.name: Panteras Pink
metas.overview: Within his less-them-tolerant Brazilian community, young Edinho faces near constant bullying for being both Black and gay. Everything changes when he, his friends and his mother organize the city's first 'Gaymada' tournament - a rollicking dodgeball competition where the players are out and proud.

metas.name: Thank You, Places
metas.overview: Actors Grant and Jimmy fell for one another while working on a dreadful community theater play. Now that Grant has dumped Jimmy before the play’s run has ended, they have to find a way to make it through a performance without killing one another. ‘Thank You, Places’ is a love letter to theater, queer romance and the jaded and idealistic artists at war inside each of us.

metas.name: Love Is Love
metas.overview: Jumping around in time, this wildly campy Bollywood melodrama follows the relationship that develops between Aryan and Ashley, two childhood friends who found their way into one another’s open arms. When their partnership is cut short by an unexpected tragedy, an otherworldly intervention is required to bring perspective and closure to their complicated love affair.

metas.name: Pieces of Love
metas.overview: Tobe’s life is put on hold after his relationship and work take a different turn.

metas.name: O Senador
metas.overview: Senator Arthur Alencar leads a double life. In the media and to his constituents, he portrays himself as a family man and a defensor of morals and good values. However, behind the spotlight, he is entangled in corruption schemes and maintains his sexual toy, the young Renan. But everything changes when Renan meets Victor, a daring journalist who will stop at nothing to expose the senator.

metas.name: SERAPHIM: The Motion Picture
metas.overview: In the midst of a racially charged & socially turbulent Brooklyn, New York, an aspiring singer, Angel, and a reformed street thug, Druid, attempt to requite their romance while confronting a troubled past.

metas.name: People (Who Need People)
metas.overview: A recently divorced man breaks into his ex-husband's house to steal the Barbra Streisand album he gave him as an anniversary gift, only to discover that there are unresolved issues at the heart of their relationship.

metas.name: Boyfriends
metas.overview: Billy passionately welcomes home his boyfriend, Kevin... but their relationship is not what it seems. Based on a true story, Boyfriends explores modern gay culture and the desperate things we do to find intimacy.

metas.name: (Un)Free Will
metas.overview: Two gay Guardian Angels meddle with their assigned humans while bringing their past to the present.

metas.name: Love's Green Patch
metas.overview: Best friends Raja and Deva are so close that they often share the same twin bed. When Raja finally feels comfortable enough to come out as gay to his bestie, the dynamics of their relationship begin to change.

metas.name: The Writer
metas.overview: Lithuanian-American Kostas and Russian-Lithuanian Dima reconnect in New York decades after serving in the Soviet army together. They fell in love back in the 80s, and Dima joined Kostas in moving from Russia to Lithuania. But as Lithuania gained Independence in the 90s, Kostas left to study in New York, leaving Dima behind. Kostas, now an established author, has published a book based on their separation. Upon reading it, Dima pays a visit, eager to correct a few facts.

metas.name: Sacrament
metas.overview: In the 1950s, two religious young men go on a camping trip together. As their forbidden love for each other begins to boil into reality, Belford battles with his inner truth and inner demons.

metas.name: The Venmo Vanisher
metas.overview: An investigative crime mockumentary set in Los Angeles and centers around Greg who goes on a desperate search for Loine after he goes missing but still hasn’t paid Greg back from brunch.

metas.name: Stay Lost
metas.overview: A chance meeting with a nomadic musician sets an aimless and depressed young man's life on an entirely new trajectory.

metas.name: Give
metas.overview: A composer attempts to unravel the memories of his relationship with his classical singer ex-boyfriend.

metas.name: My Partner
metas.overview: Two high school boys from different social worlds experience romantic feelings for each other. Edmar, a high-performing Filipino student, and Pili, a Native Hawaiian student-athlete, learn that navigating self-growth and teenage love in Hawaiʻi is as complicated as their understanding and love for Hawaiʻi and it’s ever-changing cultural landscape.

metas.name: The Cure
metas.overview: 17-year-old Renal is brought to a sex worker by his uncle to prove his masculinity to his patriarchal father.

metas.name: Casa de Bonecas
metas.overview: We're immaterial beings. We'll always be inside of each other's heart. Day by day we mutate and get way stronger. Body, soul and blood smelling like pink.

metas.name: Making a Scene
metas.overview: An overeager teen and his eccentric mother hope an extracurricular scene rehearsal will reveal the sexuality of his mysterious drama class crush.

metas.name: Naquele Dia Escuro
metas.overview: Fabio is a young trans man mourning the end of a love affair. Louise is ill and away from her family. Amid a polarized and bigoted society, he is her caregiver while she becomes his rock. Now they have each other to learn to say goodbye.

metas.name: Antes de que te vayas
metas.overview: Mientras se toman una cabaña al interior de la Patagonia, Daniel se enfrenta a una última oportunidad para declararse ante su mejor amigo Franco antes de que el inicio de la universidad los separe.

metas.name: Family Matters
metas.overview: An inside peek into the lives and relationships between sex workers and their family members. The documentary profiles four families who share of the struggles that got them where they are today and the unconditional love that allowed them to heal together.

metas.name: Youssou et Malek
metas.overview: On a sprawling urban suburbia during a sweltering summer, two young boys in love are at an impasse. Youssou has an opportunity to study abroad with a prestigious scholarship, while his boyfriend Malek advances in his art degree at a local school. As the pair wrestle with these destinies that are pulling them apart, their friends attempt to untangle the ambitions of these star-crossed lovers, all while tensions rise with the police who patrol the neighbourhood.

metas.name: Nothing But Flowers
metas.overview: Ash y Max deben cuestionar el futuro de su relación cuando aceptan a Max en un programa de posgrado de la Costa Este. En su última noche juntos, reviven momentos de su pasado antes de ser interrumpidos por una fiesta sorpresa de despedida.

metas.name: The Least Untrue
metas.overview: Two strangers discover a devastating secret that binds them together... and offers unexpected options for the future.

metas.name: The Long Ride
metas.overview: From Muybridge and Porter, passing by John Ford and Howard Hawks, all the way to Sergio Leone, Quentin Tarantino and the Coen brothers, a story of a cowboy trying to escape death cut from over 100 films.

metas.name: גנטיקה
metas.overview: The relationship between 15 year old Hemi, and his conservative father is taking a down turn. Hemi steals money from his dad for dancing classes, and something ignites in him. Between classes he meets Dani, a russian dancer that sparks all kinds of emotions. Will Hemi’s new adventure affect his relationship with his father?

metas.name: Hotter Up Close
metas.overview: On the eve of his 30th birthday, a gay slacker must overcome his crippling insecurities in order to find love.

metas.name: ‪تطبیق
metas.overview: Shahrokh, a nine-year-old effeminate boy who is humiliated and pushed away by his family and friends, makes up his mind to adjust himself to his new identity and comes out to the people of the village.

metas.name: Velvet
metas.overview: It is a slow night at the bar and Shy twink Marcus is moping after being stood up. He then meets Ben, a charming transgender bartender dressed like a king with his robe and crown. Ben uses his charm to coax Marcus out of his shell, and the two have a special night together filled with love, lust, and romance.

metas.name: Et tu cherches quoi de beau ici?
metas.overview: In Brussels, a Chilean man looks for connection, though fear of intimacy may lead him astray.

metas.name: Under the Crescent Moon
metas.overview: A short film about a man who struggles with his sexuality.

metas.name: One Like Him
metas.overview: A Jordanian man (Karim) must find a way to tell his childhood friend and first love (Ramzi) the truth about what happened twenty years ago, when a single moment changed both their lives. When he can’t find the words, the conversation repeats, becoming increasingly surreal until he loses.

metas.name: Aš buvau Maksas
metas.overview: Max goes on a date with another guy, Tadas, whom he met online. Max feels uncomfortable and timid so Tadas decides to act on his own initiative. He tries to get to know Max as they embark on a night ride around the city but Max is evasive to talk about himself. Max feels torn between his feelings and Tadas' pressure. Eventually he breaks down and reveals his true identity.

metas.name: You Are My Sunshine
metas.overview: Tom y Joe han estado juntos durante años. Y hasta cierto punto, han estado juntos solos. You Are My Sunshine traza sus humildes comienzos en un mundo que apenas se está despertando a la homosexualidad, hasta el día de hoy, un mundo que los enfrenta a su anterior forma de ser. A medida que el presente trae más conflictos, así como un cambio potencial de aire, la historia de Tom y Joe se mostrará desde su gran primer día hasta su final amoroso.

metas.name: I Get So Sad Sometimes
metas.overview: In the small town of Pagadian, a gay teenager eagerly waits for a mature man to finally reveal his face after developing an anonymous sexual relationship with him online.

metas.name: The Word
metas.overview: A young boy and his father arguing on the road while the son teaching his father how to drive. Gradually, the tension between the two increases and causes a conflict between them.

metas.name: Skinny Fat
metas.overview: A gay man confronts his belly fat in a shop changing room, triggering him to relive an abusive past relationship. But who can save him from his own body?

metas.name: If I'm Good
metas.overview: A widower explores his attraction to a younger man as he struggles to cope with the recent loss of his husband.

metas.name: Sapphire
metas.overview: Ethan struggles with addiction to love and drugs. He creates an alter ego in the glamorous Sapphire but will his fantasy life be enough to save him from his inner demons?

metas.name: ο Άγγελος τα Χριστούγεννα
metas.overview: It is Christmas Eve. Angelos, a mysterious 50-year-old man, observes a young boy singing the carols in the streets of Athens. He convinces the child to go with him in his car towards an unknown destination.

metas.name: Ječam žela
metas.overview: Jakov invites his old friend Petar, who lives abroad, to be the godfather at his daughter's baptism. His arrival awakens deeply suppressed memories of their relationship, and Petar fails to resist his temptation and secretly tries to reach Jakov, who's aware that he has taken a false identity in order to assimilate into the milieu.

metas.name: Paxmal
metas.overview: Theo and Louis, two gay gentlemen, embark on a train journey to Paxmal. They are carrying an urn - it is the last journey for a friend. On their way deep into the Swiss Alps the two men, struggling with their fate, meet various people. While some of these people remind Theo and Louis again of the beautiful things in life, others confront them with ghosts from the past.

metas.name: Reviens mon amour
metas.overview: A tortured man is annihilated ever since the disappearance of his loved one. To cope with this intolerable loss, he becomes capable of anything. He seeks in others what will fill the absence in his heart in order to recreate a lost love.

metas.name: Xmas Eve Eve
metas.overview: Xmas eve eve brings us back to a cold night in December 2020, in Queens, New York under semi-lockdown, where a chase between ex-lovers Dennis and Tom is happening within the overhead subway train.

metas.name: Al mar
metas.overview: Ana y Diego son una pareja que decide irse a vivir a la costa de Chile. Allí conocen a Vicente, con quien Diego entabla una relación en secreto. Ana, por su parte, debe decidir si quiere abrirse a una relación que deconstruye las formas tradicionales de relacionarse afectivamente.
